description: In a well-order of uncountable cofinality, a map from a stationary set into fewer than the cofinality many values has a stationary fiber.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.stationary_small_fiber.{u, v} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) {β : Type v}
  (hβ : Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Cardinal.mk β) < Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Order.cof α)) {S : Set α} (hS : IsStationary S)
  (f : α → β) : ∃ b, IsStationary (S ∩ f ⁻¹' {b})
